blocks.text: Congratulations are in order for Canadian-American actor Jim Carrey, as he married a longtime partner, marking his third marriage. Celebrity news website TMZ reported that the 64-year-old actor tied the knot with his longtime girlfriend Min Ah at a small ceremony in Los Angeles. Not much is known about Ah, who is said to be in her early 30s. Carrey and Ah were first spotted together in 2022 leaving a charity comedy show in Los Angeles, according to entertainment news website Just Jared.
